en.headline: Bar Association tells High Court tribunal erred in clearing Margaret Ng
en.dek: Senior counsel argued the disciplinary panel overlooked the likelihood that Ng’s 2019 unlawful assembly conviction brought the profession into disrepute.
body: The Hong Kong Bar Association told the High Court on Monday that a disciplinary tribunal erred when it cleared barrister and former lawmaker Margaret Ng of professional misconduct.

The complaint arose from Ng’s conviction for taking part in an unauthorised assembly in 2019. The association argued that the tribunal had overlooked the likelihood that her actions brought the legal profession into disrepute.

Benjamin Yu Yuk-hoi SC, representing the association, said the council had applied for judicial review to revoke the tribunal’s decision and to seek clarification of the code of conduct. The Barristers Disciplinary Tribunal had earlier found the complaint unsubstantiated.

High Court Judge Queeny Au-Yeung questioned whether the outcome would be academic given that Ng has retired from practice. Yu replied that the conduct in question occurred while she was still in active practice.
The judicial review hearing continues. The association is not seeking further punishment against Ng beyond the clarification of the code.

zh.headline: 大律師公會向高院指紀律審裁組錯判吳霧儀無失當
zh.dek: 資深大律師陳詞指審裁組忽略吳霧儀2019年非法集結定罪可能令專業蒙羞。
body: 香港大律師公會周一在高等法院表示，紀律審裁組裁定大律師兼前立法會議員吳霧儀無專業失當的決定有誤。
有關投訴源於吳霧儀2019年參與未經批准集結被定罪。公會指審裁組忽略了其行為可能令法律專業蒙羞的可能性。
代表公會的資深大律師余若海表示，執委會申請司法覆核，要求推翻審裁組決定並釐清行為守則。大律師紀律審裁組較早前裁定投訴不成立。
高等法院法官歐陽桂如質疑，鑑於吳霧儀已退休，聲訊結果會否屬學術性質。余若海回應指涉事行為發生時她仍在執業。
司法覆核聲訊繼續進行。公會並非尋求對吳霧儀作出進一步懲處，主要是釐清守則。
